newsitem.title: USA: EVEREN in alliance with LaSalle Natl Bank.
newsitem.headline: EVEREN in alliance with LaSalle Natl Bank.

text.p: EVEREN Securities Inc, a subsidiary of EVEREN Capital Corp, and LaSalle National Bank announced an alliance Tuesday to provide brokerage and financial services to their respective clients.

Under the agreement, which is effective immediately, LaSalle will become a preferred provider of personal trust, fiduciary and trust administration services to EVEREN clients that want them and the brokerage firm will have sole investment management responsibility for trust accounts naming LaSalle as trustee, the two announced in a news release.
The alliance requires no capital investment from either participant. Chicago-based LaSalle is a subsidiary of Netherlands-based ABN AMRO Holding NV.
